title: automation: moving a flow from one package to another strands its paused runs (409 RESUME_TARGET_LOST), with no platform path to carry them over
body:
repo:hotcrm#2 · os-mickey · session_01ASNY8XiE8ZJYbrmzFDtS9g

**Filing gate ①**: a defect measured once.

**Business reason.** An app that moves an approval flow between its packages (HotCRM moved two project-path approvals from Expenses to Project Delivery, objectstack-ai/hotcrm PR #2678) strands every approval pending at upgrade time. Deciding it answers `409 RESUME_TARGET_LOST` ("Flow app.objectstack.hotcrm.expense/expense_report_project_approval not found"). The only recovery is manual: recall, an admin sets Draft, then resubmit.

**Reach.** Measured in PR #2678. A database booted on the base release with pending records, then the moved flows on the same database. Deciding the request answers 409 for both the report and the travel request.

**Expected:** a paused run survives a flow moving package within one app, or the platform offers a declared move (an alias) that re-keys pending runs.

**Seam.** `runtime:automation` resume, where a paused run is keyed by package and flow name.

**Dedupe:** `RESUME_TARGET_LOST flow package move paused run` returned 7 hits. The nearest is #23963 (closed: RUN_NOT_FOUND on resume), which has a different cause.

**Reader.** objectstack triage grades it and routes it to the owning lane. Not a claim; awaits triage. Filed on the maintainer's word in hotcrm seat 2's session (2026-11-19): 「平台缺口全部立卡」, after an independent fable-tier review of HotCRM's pending decisions surfaced it.
